statement: Parse returns null unless the text contains ANSI or AAMVA.
Parse returns null when no number, first name or last name is found.
Element codes match only at line start or in the header line, never inside a value.
Blank and NONE values are treated as absent.
Output keys are number, name, date_of_birth, expires, sex, class and address when present.
Name is first, middle, last title-cased from DAC/DCT, DAD, DCS/DAB.
Legacy payloads take the name from a single comma-separated DAA field.
8-digit dates read as MMDDCCYY or CCYYMMDD and output as ISO.
Sex maps 1/M to M and 2/F to F, otherwise omitted.
Address is title-cased street, city and state.
TD3 passport MRZ is parsed into all fields.
TD1 ID card MRZ is parsed with the name on line 3.
TD2 MRZ is parsed with the name on line 1.
Surrounding text and OCR spacing are ignored.
Parse returns null when no MRZ is present.
numberValid reflects the document-number check digit and filler is stripped.
Dates with a failed check digit or impossible day are dropped.
Birth years pivot on nowYear; expiry is always 20YY.
documentType is the first MRZ character.
OCR repair rejoins split filler, pads short lines and maps guillemet and paren confusables.
Digit look-alikes in country codes are mapped to letters.
Names split at << and are title-cased; fullName is given then surname.
recognize returns lines with text, confidence and box, and fullText joins them.
recognize returns an empty result on null or platform errors.
recognizeBarcodes returns payloads or an empty list on null or errors.
detectDocumentRect returns a normalized rect or null on null or errors.
Base CaptureService defaults barcodes to empty and document rect to null.
FakeCaptureService returns canned results and can be built from lines.
